settings.title: A plain rug, fully yours
settings.text: TAILOR-MADE is a plain rug in cut pile with every choice open: the material, the pile height, the colour, the shape and the size. See the price as you choose and order online.

settings.subheading: For a design of your own
settings.title: Price guide
settings.text: Choose a craft level, a material and a size to see what your rug would cost. Prices include [vat]% VAT.
settings.design_text: The craft level measures how demanding a design is to make. It sets the price per m².
settings.design_note: Not sure which level your design is? Choose the closest: we confirm it when we have seen the design.
settings.library_text: Starting from a design of our library?
settings.library_link_text: Choose it in the design library
settings.material_text: One material sets the guide. A rug can mix several.
settings.shape_text: For a round or irregular shape, give the size of the rectangle it fits in.
settings.shipping_text: Artwork and sampling come before production. Delivery is quoted for each order.
settings.summary_note: A guide, not a quote. We confirm the price when we have seen your design.

settings.title: After your request
settings.text: A bespoke rug is drawn, sampled and approved before it is made.

settings.label: Artwork
settings.value: We draw your rug and send you the artwork to approve.

settings.label: Sample
settings.value: You approve the design, the texture and the colours on a sample.

settings.label: Production
settings.value: [lead_weeks] weeks, or [priority_weeks] with priority production, for [priority_percent]% more.

settings.title: Ask for a proposal
settings.text: Tell us about your project. We answer by e-mail, with questions or with a proposal: the artwork of your rug, its price and its production time.
settings.note: You can send drawings and photographs by e-mail once we reply. We use your details only to answer this request.
settings.success: Thank you. Your request has been sent, and we will answer by e-mail.
